notes: External smart-contract audit (R-01) not yet engaged. Every contract in contracts/src is Base Sepolia testnet-only until it clears. Mainnet escrow boot is fenced by composition/escrow-audit-gate.ts (which ALSO requires this file's status to be 'approved'), and check-audit-status.mjs forbids marking 'approved' without an auditor, an audited 40-hex commit, a report reference, and zero unresolved critical/high findings. Approval ALSO binds to the audited build (P1): compiler (solc_version/optimizer_enabled/optimizer_runs/evm_version), contract_source_tree_sha256, and creation/runtime_bytecode_sha256, plus approved_chain_ids and immutable_references. runtime_bytecode_sha256 is the IMMUTABLE-MASKED runtime hash (the immutable_references byte ranges are zeroed before hashing) so the api's mainnet escrow boot fence can compare it against the on-chain eth_getCode result. NOTE: BrainEscrow now has NO immutables (arbiter became a storage variable so it can be rotated two-step), so immutable_references is expected to be an empty list and the masked hash equals the plain runtime hash. Populate these from `node scripts/verify-audited-build.mjs` (run after `forge build`) using the auditor's final report; that tool also re-verifies them in CI so a contract or toolchain change after the audited commit fails the build. Update this file ONLY from the auditor's final report. SCOPE GAP TO CLOSE BEFORE MAINNET: this record covers BrainEscrow only, but BrainSmartAccount custodies tenant ETH and ERC-20 balances and delegates spending authority to session keys, so it is the higher-risk contract and currently has no boot fence, no audit gate, and no deployed-bytecode verification. BrainAuditAnchor, BrainPolicyRegistry, BrainMCPAgentRegistry and BrainReputationRegistry are likewise ungated. ACCEPTED RISK (audit remediation, deliberate non-fix): the audit-anchor Merkle tree duplicates a trailing odd node, so a root does not commit to the leaf COUNT and [A,B,C] hashes to the same root as [A,B,C,C]. Binding the count would invalidate every anchor already published on Base Sepolia and force a dual-scheme verifier; the 0x00/0x01 leaf-vs-internal domain separation already blocks the exploitable case (presenting an internal node as a leaf). Re-evaluate if the anchor contract is ever redeployed with no historical roots to preserve.
